messages:
Zoe R: Creating follow-up thread for last-nights partial-response + silent-close incidents on /v1/streaming-chat. Want to track owners and short remediation plan.
Lin (SRE): Thanks Zoe. Any concise repro/logs we can attach?
Zoe R: Reduced log: 
```
[01:12:07] conn=xy01 event=token_chunk bytes=512
[01:12:07] conn=xy01 event=HALF_CHUNK
[01:12:07] conn=xy01 tcp=FIN_SENT err=EOF
```
Hector - Runtime: Matches SDK traces showing socket close right after partial chunk. Suspect LB idle or envoy upstream restart.
Anya: I'll check ALB and envoy idle/keepalive metrics; scheduling canary with extended idle timeout.
InfraBot: Change ticket created: INFRA-1309 (ALB idle-timeout tweak).
Lin (SRE): Proposed owners: Hector=SDK + runtime resume logic, Anya=LB/Envoy + canary, Zoe=customer comms + PM update, Lin=alerts + dashboards.
Zoe R: Immediate mitigations: (1) enable small app-level heartbeat (hb frame every 15s), (2) enable SO_KEEPALIVE on runtime sockets, (3) add detection metric partial_chunks/total_chunks and alert at 0.15% over 10m.
Hector - Runtime: I'll add heartbeat in runtime and a short SDK patch: jittered backoff + resume-on-409. Example: 
```
backoff_ms = min(800 * 2**attempt, 16000) + rand(0,150)
if status == 409: resume_from_last_token()
```
Anya: I'm going to run canary with ALB idle 180s in 1h window and report results here. Rollback plan documented in INFRA-1309.
Lin (SRE): Detection: I'll add a grafana panel and pager rule; will correlate with envoy upstream_reset_rate.
Zoe R: Timeline: detection + alert in 12h; heartbeat + SDK patch in 36h; ALB change canary in 6h; pcap capture and analysis in 48h; customer note in 72h.
Hector - Runtime: PR opened for heartbeat + resume unit tests: https://git.internal/runtime/pulls/550
Anya: Canary started. Posting graphs in ~2h.
Lin (SRE): Also adding an automated synthetic that simulates mid-stream close to validate resume behavior. Hector, can you add to ci/synthetics?
Hector - Runtime: Yep, will add a synthetic that injects mid-stream RST and assert successful resume.
Zoe R: Action recap: Hector (runtime/SDK patches + synthetics), Anya (ALB canary + metrics), Lin (detection + pager), Zoe (comms + PM). Please update INFRA-1309 and runtime PR with status.
InfraBot: Reminder: attach rollback notes to INFRA-1309 before applying change.
Maya S: Thanks team. Quick sync tomorrow 09:00 if canary shows any anomalies. Ping in-thread for blockers. :white_check_mark:
